posts.text:
Michigan’s been revolutionizing how we get around for over a century.

We’re #1 for mobility, electrification, and automotive R&D and we’re not stopping there. Michigan will keep building the future of mobility on land, in the air, and on our waters.

It’s never too late to reconnect with your dreams. If you’re looking for opportunity, signing up for a tuition-free education is simple:

1. Visit Michigan.gov/reconnect

2. Find a participating community college or skills center.

3. Start learning and earning!

I commend the efforts of Attorney General Nessel, Romulus Mayor McCraight, and our state and federal lawmakers for putting a stop to this facility.


Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel (@MIAttyGen)

The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Agency has decided to abandon its plans to convert the Romulus warehouse into an immigration detention center and instead will sell the facility. Read the AG's full statement and learn more at go.mi.gov/peqnb2725
